Schedule: 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM (USA – Los Angeles Time) Role Overview: The Monitoring Engineer will track team productivity, attendance, and conduct across shifts and job sites. This includes real-time monitoring via Google Meet, updating attendance and schedules, KPI scoring, and reporting issues through WhatsApp. Key Responsibilities: •Monitor team members via Google Meet every 10–15 minutes and take screenshots. •Update attendance and work schedules in Google Sheets. •Track WhatsApp activity during breaks and follow up on late returns. •Evaluate workers using Ethics KPI and Job KPI (focus, speed, vibe). •For 2nd/3rd shifts and weekends: monitor job site activities via Reolink, report incidents, and escalate as needed. •Must-Have Requirements (Equipment & Skills): Strong laptop or PC: •Laptop: Intel Core i5 13th Gen / PC: Intel Core i5 12th Gen •RAM: 24 GB minimum •Laptop + monitor OR PC + 2 monitors •Stable, fast internet: minimum 30 Mbps •Knowledge of Google Sheets •Attention to detail, time management, and good communication Tools Used: Google Meet, WhatsApp, Google Sheets, Reolink App, Screenshot utilities Performance Metrics: •Accuracy of attendance and schedules •Timeliness of KPI reports •Responsiveness in reporting issues To Apply: Send your resume and screenshot of your laptop/PC specs  to kfatima@midconstruction.com  with the subject line: Monitoring Engineer.
